crossRefs.note: Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.
Now, behold, the king walks before you. I am old and gray-headed. Behold, my sons are with you. I have walked before…
Hezekiah did so throughout all Judah; and he did that which was good, right, and faithful before Yahweh his God.
In every work that he began in the service of God’s house, in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did…
But the former governors who were before me were supported by the people, and took bread and wine from them, plus forty…
There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and…
and said, “Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have…
They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.
none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.
But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me.
Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.
who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify for himself a people for his own…
knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed…
but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,
who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,
who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,
He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.
Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
Remember me, my God, concerning this, and don’t wipe out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and…
I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify…
and for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the first fruits. Remember me, my God, for good.

translations.web: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
translations.bsb: But I will walk with integrity; redeem me and be merciful to me.
translations.kjv: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful
translations.asv: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: Redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
